title: GTA 6 Devs Avoided Passing Trends to Create Original Satire
description: GTA 6 developers reportedly avoided jumping on passing trends during development, opting instead to create their own exaggerated and unique versions.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Challenge of Timely Satire in Long-Term Development

Creating a timely satire can be exceptionally tough when a major game development cycle takes half a decade or more. It is a well-known industry hurdle; for instance, it is the primary reason why animated shows like South Park have stuck with their crude art style for literal decades, allowing them to turn around episodes quickly. However, the developers of a massive, world-class blockbuster like GTA 6 obviously cannot just replace their cutting-edge technology with paper cutouts to match the news cycle.

Recently, insights from gaming outlet Eurogamer shed light on how the development team has approached this creative dilemma. Instead of desperately trying to cram in every fleeting viral moment, the team reportedly tried to actively avoid trends that would inevitably become outdated by the time the game actually launches.

## Creating "Slanted, Overblown Versions" Instead

Chasing the internet's latest cultural waves during a lengthy development process is a trap that many entertainment properties fall into, often resulting in content that feels cringeworthy or dated by the time it reaches the audience. To circumvent this, the team behind GTA 6 focused on a different approach.

Rather than jumping on the bandwagon of passing trends, the developers turned their attention to crafting their own "slanted, overblown versions" of modern culture. This philosophy aligns with the historical DNA of the franchise, which has always thrived on taking real-world absurdities and dialing them up to an 11. By creating exaggerated, satirical parodies rather than directly referencing specific short-lived memes, the developers are aiming to build a world that retains its satirical bite and relevance long after release.

While details remain centered around this creative philosophy as highlighted by Eurogamer, the decision to steer clear of ephemeral internet fads speaks volumes about the team's long-term vision for the open-world experience.

## Editor's Take

Avoiding the trap of fleeting internet trends is a smart move for a game with a development cycle as long as GTA 6. By focusing on creating their own over-the-top, timeless satirical versions of society, the developers are ensuring that the humor and world-building will age gracefully rather than feeling like an outdated meme compilation upon launch.
